d: Nishant Kumar Controversy : bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki sikyoriti ka ek vidiyo soshal midiya par vayral hone ke bad siyasi vivad khara ho gaya hai... vidiyo men mukhyamantri ke sath maujud svasthy mantri nishant kumar ko ek surakshakarmi aage barhne se rokta aur pichhe karta dikhaee deta hai... yah ghatna 18 navanbar ko vaishali men nitish setu ke nirikshan ke dauran huee thi... mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri pradhanmantri narendr modi ke prastavit daure ki taiyariyon ka jayja lene pahunche the... isi dauran nishant kumar ko suraksha ghere ke pas roka gaya
